children.value: > Fact From Story With two matches remaining in the season, Inter Miami have been officially eliminated from the MLS playoff race, with Supporters’ Shield winners FC Cincinnati dealing the deathblow with a 1-0 victory at DRV PNK Stadium.
> > Fact From Story The match had every hallmark of what made Inter Miami a flawed side when Lionel Messi arrived.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A team must win games to be in contention for the playoffs.
> Fact From Story Inter Miami were in simply too big of a hole in the MLS playoff race, one which even Lionel Messi couldn’t drag them out of.
> Commonsense Knowledge A team that is eliminated from the playoff race cannot win the playoffs.
